1) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is selected from the group consisting of 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof. (Currently amended)

3) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, wherein the composition is applied to the skin of a subject in need of treatment for skin conditions. (Currently amended)

5) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight, for the purpose of improving the skin's appearance. (Currently amended)

7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition suitable for skin health. (Currently amended)

8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of skin diseases associated with defective keratinization, specifically for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, and similar conditions impacting skin health. (Currently amended)

10) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation, or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair, assisting in maintaining good skin and hair health. (Currently amended)

12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening, aimed at enhancing the overall skin appearance. (Currently amended)

13) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin, for promoting smooth skin texture. (Currently amended)

14) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced aging processes of the human skin or hair, specifically targeting dryness and wrinkle formation, while also aiming to reduce the harmful effects of UV rays on skin health. (Currently amended)
